name: Shoalglass
author: E. T. Carter
description: Clear shallow water over a dark rippled sand floor seen down the beach: thin orchid-white caustic filaments fold and pinch into drifting loops and arcs over the sand and half-sunk pebbles, sharp underfoot and softening into a blue-black haze in the distance.

params.label: Swell
params.effect: How fast the surface swell slides the caustic filaments across the sand.

params.label: Focus
params.effect: How hard the surface focuses light, from a soft dapple to tight knotted filaments.

params.label: Clarity
params.effect: How far down the beach the floor stays visible before the water haze takes it.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Brightness of the caustic light on sand and stones.
